$comment: Agency 2026 sound cues: every sound moment of an event day. The show player (show/) reads this file. Build ready cues with node scripts/audio-prep.mjs --all; add a generated Suno file with node scripts/audio-prep.mjs <id> <file>. Field guide: guides/SOUND.md.

palette.name: Agency signal
palette.description: Cinematic electronic with organic percussion: taiko, claps and toms under bright analog-synth plucks, a warm sub bass and airy pads; strings and brass only for triumph.
palette.signature_motif: A rising three-note pluck arpeggio, D - F sharp - A (1-3-5), landing on one taiko and clap hit. It opens every sting and bumper.

day_motifs.1: blue, The Art of the Possible: bright and curious, piano and pluck, D major, 100 bpm
day_motifs.2: plum, Research and the Future AI Economy: thoughtful and warm, cello pizzicato and pad, B minor, 92 bpm
day_motifs.3: orange, Alberta Velocity: driving, punchy drums and synth bass, D major, 104 bpm

loudness.video: embedded videos are mastered to -16 LUFS

cues.use: Doors open and walk-in; the holding loop on the stage and lobby screens

suno.style: cinematic electronic, organic percussion, taiko, claps, bright analog synth plucks, arpeggiator, warm sub bass, airy pads, steady mid-tempo groove, 94 bpm, A minor, minimal, hypnotic, no build
suno.prompt: A steady, confident groove for people finding their seats. Light taiko pulse, muted plucks, warm pad. Even energy from start to end, no build, no breakdown, so it loops cleanly.
suno.exclude: vocals, singing, choir vocals, spoken word, lyrics, rap, lo-fi, dubstep, heavy distortion, EDM drop, vinyl crackle

cues.use: Under MG-04 session countdown: the last 5 minutes before a session

source.note: interim: the walk-in loop until a dedicated countdown bed is generated

suno.style: cinematic electronic, organic percussion, taiko, claps, bright analog synth plucks, arpeggiator, warm sub bass, airy pads, 100 bpm, D major, pulsing, anticipation, slow rise over five minutes
suno.prompt: Five minutes of gentle anticipation under a countdown. A ticking hi-hat pulse and plucked arpeggio that slowly gains layers. Ends cleanly on a downbeat with no big hit (the opening sting does that).
suno.exclude: vocals, singing, choir vocals, spoken word, lyrics, rap, lo-fi, dubstep, heavy distortion, EDM drop, vinyl crackle

cues.notes: Interim file loops the walk-in bed at a higher level. Generate the dedicated bed and re-run audio-prep.
